mapper.sql: menu_cd, menu_nm_kr, menu_nm_en, menu_nm_mn, menu_no, menu_lvl, top_menu_cd, url, use_yn, sys_gen_dt AS sys_crt_dt, sys_crt_usr_id, sys_mdfcn_dt AS sys_upd_dt, sys_mdfr_id AS sys_upd_usr_id, menu_unq_no AS menu_seq, menu_icon, prgm_url
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE user_context AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.eml, u.role, ug.grp_id, ug.user_up_grp_id, dg.grp_nm, dg.up_grp_id FROM SYS_USER u LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_GRP ug ON u.id = ug.id LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPT_GRP dg ON CONVERT(dg.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(ug.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE CONVERT(u.eml USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(#{user_email} USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ), accessible_menus AS ( SELECT DISTINCT cm.* FROM SYS_MENU cm WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_context uc WHERE LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(uc.role, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) IN ('system', 'developer') OR LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(uc.grp_id, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) IN ('system', 'developer') OR LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(uc.user_up_grp_id, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) IN ('system', 'developer') OR LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(uc.grp_nm, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) IN ('system', 'developer') OR LOWER(CONVERT(COALESCE(uc.up_grp_id, '') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) IN ('system', 'developer') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ACS_GRP_MENU sagm WHERE CONVERT(sagm.menu_cd USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(cm.menu_cd USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_context uc WHERE CONVERT(uc.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(sagm.grp_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ) ) UNION SELECT parent.* FROM SYS_MENU parent JOIN accessible_menus child ON CONVERT(child.top_menu_cd USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = CONVERT(parent.menu_cd USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci ) SELECT DISTINCT menu_cd, menu_nm_kr, menu_nm_en, menu_nm_mn, menu_no, menu_lvl, top_menu_cd, url, use_yn, sys_gen_dt AS sys_crt_dt, sys_crt_usr_id, sys_mdfcn_dt AS sys_upd_dt, sys_mdfr_id AS sys_upd_usr_id, menu_unq_no AS menu_seq, menu_icon, prgm_url FROM accessible_menus WHERE use_yn = '1' ORDER BY menu_lvl, menu_seq
